text: sed -n 45,70p src/types/error_constants.rs: ("E_USER_NOTICE", 1024), ("E_STRICT", 2048), ("E_RECOVERABLE_ERROR", 4096), ("E_DEPRECATED", 8192), ("E_USER_DEPRECATED", 16384), ("E_ALL", 32767), ]; for (name, value) in expected { let entry = ERROR_LEVEL_CONSTANTS .iter() .find(|(n, _)| n == name) .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{name} defined")); assert_eq!(entry.1, *value, "{name} value mismatch"); } } /// Asserts no duplicate names exist in `ERROR_LEVEL_CONSTANTS`. #[test] fn no_duplicate_constant_names() { let mut names: Vec<&str> = ERROR_LEVEL_CONSTANTS.iter().map(|(n, _)| *n).collect(); names.sort_unstable(); let len_before = names.len(); names.dedup(); assert_eq!(names.len(), len_before, "duplicate error-level constant name"); } }
